name: Expressive Window Crasher Ghosts, Set Of Three Halloween Decoration - Grandin Road
description: Take your spooky d cor to a whole new dimension, with our Expressive Window Crasher Ghosts that appear both inside and outside your house! Thanks to hidden suction cups and a window cling that looks like broken glass, you can install these puffy pranksters so that they appear to be bursting right through your window panes, each a different expression on their face. While arms and tails are light enough to bob in the breeze (and add to the eeriness), sturdy suction cups ensure their bodies stay put, where they're to grab the most attention. Set of three ghost heads and three ghost tails that "crash" through your windows . Soft construction and fluttering tails means they respond to breezes . Set includes three ghosts, each with a different expression, including surprise, anxiety, and not-so-happy-to-crash . Improved suction cups are designed to firmly secure body to clean window surface, so each ghost stays exactly where it's strategically placed . Window cling on ghosts is made of plastic and is reusable . Wipe clean with a damp cloth and allow to dry before storing away; use mild detergent if necessary . Imported .
